<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service facility"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceVisit" name="Car service visit"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentViaApp" name="Payment via app"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Police" name="Police Car Service Reminder App" processRef="Process_Police"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NotifyOwner" name="Service due notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusEmail" name="Status update email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusEmail" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarBrought" name="Car brought" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceVisit" name="Car service visit" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment via app" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service completed" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceCompleted" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Police" name="Police Car Service Reminder App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner that service is due"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForVisit" name="Wait for service visit"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceVisit" name="Car service visit">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceVisit" messageRef="Msg_ServiceVisit"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 days without service">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FineOwner" name="Fine owner for missed service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit recorded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered, no notification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckRegistration" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegistrationChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notified" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForVisit" targetRef="Catch_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForVisit" targetRef="Timer_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitDone" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceVisit" targetRef="End_VisitRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerExpired" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Task_FineOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine" sourceRef="Task_FineOwner" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service facility">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarBrought" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusEmail" name="Send status update via email"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Payment" name="Payment via app received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Msg_PaymentViaApp"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and hand over Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceCompleted" name="Send service completed to police app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Facility" name="Service completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarBrought" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_SendStatusEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusEmail" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Catch_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Task_SendServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceCompleted" targetRef="End_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
